column7: RECOVERY-MFA-RESET-1: an approved MFA reset is a full credential reset, never MFA off: TOTP secret, recovery codes and WebAuthn flag gone, every session row deleted and every PAT revoked, password replaced by the returned one-time password, account password_reset_required and mfa_enrolment_required set; the target and every admin are notified. Host-command sibling: ./server/admin TestPerformResetMFA_FullCredentialReset.
